43298-the-riddle-and-the-ring-or-won-by-.creator: Unknown
43298-the-riddle-and-the-ring-or-won-by-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Was it possible that the intolerable persecution had begun again? For more than three weeks he had been left in peace, and it seemed the irony of fate that now, at a moment when he was tasting the bitter dregs of life, the harassing should begin again.

arxiv-1805-08332.title: Storage and Memory Characterization of Data Intensive Workloads for Bare Metal Cloud
arxiv-1805-08332.creator: Hosein Mohammadi Makrani
arxiv-1805-08332.description: Abstract As the cost-per-byte of storage systems dramatically decreases, SSDs are finding their ways in emerging cloud infrastructure. Similar trend is happening for main memory subsystem, as advanced DRAM technologies with higher capacity, frequency and number of channels are deploying for cloud-scale solutions specially for non-virtualized environment where cloud subscribers can exactly specify the configuration of underling hardware.

arxiv-2003-11962.title: A micro-macro Markov chain Monte Carlo method for molecular dynamics using reaction coordinate proposals II: indirect reconstruction
arxiv-2003-11962.creator: Hannes Vandecasteele, Giovanni Samaey
arxiv-2003-11962.description: Abstract We introduce a new micro-macro Markov chain Monte Carlo method (mM-MCMC) with indirect reconstruction to sample invariant distributions of molecular dynamics systems that exhibit a time-scale separation between the microscopic (fast) dynamics, and the macroscopic (slow) dynamics of some low-dimensional set of reaction coordinates.

arxiv-2110-12104.title: Data Fitting with Signomial Programming Compatible Difference of Convex Functions
arxiv-2110-12104.creator: Cody Karcher
arxiv-2110-12104.description: Abstract Signomial Programming (SP) has proven to be a powerful tool for engineering design optimization, striking a balance between the computational efficiency of Geometric Programming (GP) and the extensibility of more general optimization methods like Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP). But when an existing engineering analysis tool is incompatible with the mathematics of the SP formulation, options are limited.

arxiv-2110-15790.description: Abstract The big data about music history contains information about time and users’ behavior. Researchers could predict the trend of popular songs accurately by analyzing this data. The traditional trend prediction models can better predict the short trend than the long trend.

arxiv-2301-06691.title: Circumventing the Phonon Bottleneck by Multiphonon-Mediated Hot Exciton Cooling at the Nanoscale
arxiv-2301-06691.creator: Dipti Jasrasaria, Eran Rabani
arxiv-2301-06691.description: Abstract In semiconductor materials, hot exciton cooling is the process by which highly excited carriers nonradiatively relax to form a band edge exciton. While cooling plays an important role in determining the thermal losses and quantum yield of a system, the timescales and mechanism of cooling are not well understood in confined semiconductor nanocrystals (NCs).

arxiv-2402-04565.title: Spaces of metrics are Baire
arxiv-2402-04565.creator: Yoshito Ishiki
arxiv-2402-04565.description: Abstract . For a metrizable space, we consider the space of all metrics generating the same topology of the metrizable space, and this space of metrics is equipped with the supremum metric. In this paper, for every metrizable space, we establish that the space of metrics on the metrizable space is Baire.

arxiv-2508-10116.title: Bridging Modality Gaps in e-Commerce Products via Vision-Language Alignment DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 Thanks: Equal contribution. CCS: Information systems Language models CCS: Information systems Multimedia and multimodal retrieval
arxiv-2508-10116.creator: Yipeng Zhang, Hongjun Yu, Aritra Mandal, Canran Xu, Qunzhi Zhou, Zhe Wu
arxiv-2508-10116.description: Abstract . Item information, such as titles and attributes, is essential for effective user engagement in e-commerce. However, manual or semi-manual entry of structured item specifics often results in inconsistent data quality, errors, and a time-intensive process, particularly for Customer-to-Customer sellers. Generating these descriptions directly from item images offers a promising solution.

arxiv-2508-18233.title: Diffusiophoretic corner flows
arxiv-2508-18233.creator: Dobromir Nowak, Maciej Lisicki
arxiv-2508-18233.description: Abstract We study flows induced in a two-dimensional corner by the chemical activity of the confining boundaries. A catalytic reaction on the surfaces drives the diffusiophoretic flow of viscous fluid in the whole domain. We show that phoretically active sectors can generate eddies in the corner, similar to Moffatt eddies, induced mechanically in a similar confinement.

pmc-11402533.title: Malaysia's rainfall and Kalumpang agricultural station data for scattered data interpolation
pmc-11402533.creator: Samsul Ariffin Abdul Karim, Owen Tamin
pmc-11402533.description: Scattered data interpolation is an essential technique used in environmental, geospatial and meteorological analysis. It enables the estimation of unknown values within a dataset at the domain by utilising known data points. The utilisation of this method is crucial to generate smooth and continuous surfaces from discrete data, facilitating the creation of more precise models and visualisations of environmental events.

pmc-11450255.title: Combining Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping With the Gray Matter Volume to Predict Neurological Deficits in Patients With Small Artery Occlusion
pmc-11450255.creator: Xuelian Tang, Zhenzhen He, Qian Yang, Tao Yang, Yusheng Yu, Jinan Chen
pmc-11450255.description: BackgroundCurrently, there is still a lack of valuable neuroimaging markers to assess the clinical severity of stroke patients with small artery occlusion (SAO). Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) is a quantitative processing method for neuroradiological diagnostics. Gray matter (GM) volume changes in stroke patients are also proved to be associated with neurological deficits.

pmc-12534510.title: A performance analysis of convolutional autoencoder modified WaveGAN architectures for realistic 12 lead electrocardiogram synthesis
pmc-12534510.creator: Jiaqi Liu, Kwok Tai Chui, Lap-Kei Lee, Kenneth Lo, Aimin Yang, Edmond King Sing Fong
pmc-12534510.description: The burgeoning necessity for copious and diverse electrocardiogram (ECG) datasets for deep learning applications in clinical diagnostics has been impeded by the confidential nature of patient data. Related works have shown the effectiveness of additional data generation in enhancing the deep learning models’ performance.

pmc-12579108.title: Smad7 ameliorate small airway remodeling in COPD by modulating epithelial-mesenchymal transition
pmc-12579108.creator: Xianyang Liu, Shenghua Sun, Shengyang He, Lihua Xie
pmc-12579108.description: INTRODUCTIONSmall airway remodeling is a key pathological feature of COPD, yet its mechanisms remain unclear. TGF-β1 induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), contributing to airway remodeling. Smad7 is a negative regulator of TGF-β signaling, but its role in COPD remains undefined. This study investigates whether Smad7 suppresses TGF-β1-induced EMT in COPD small airway remodeling.

pmc-13129566.title: Comparison of Short-Term Outcomes of Tetralogy of Fallot Repair Between Preserved Pulmonary Valve Annulus and Transannular Patch
pmc-13129566.creator: Md Raisul Islam, Mushtaq Mutashid Muhib, Mohammad Sharifuzzaman, Deepta Majumder
pmc-13129566.description: Background: Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) repair may involve either preservation of the pulmonary valve annulus (PVA) or use of a transannular patch (TAP) with a polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) bicuspid pulmonary valve. This study aimed to compare short-term clinical and echocardiographic outcomes of TOF repair using preserved PVA versus TAP with PTFE valve.

pmc-13179475.title: Prevalence and Factors Associated With Nocturia (≥ 2 Night‐Time Urinary Episodes) in Japan: Analysis of the 2023 Japan Community Health Survey (JaCS 2023)
pmc-13179475.creator: Satoru Kira, Hiroshi Shimura, Takanori Mochizuki, Norifumi Sawada, Noritoshi Sekido, Naoya Masumori, Yoshiyuki Kojima, Takahiko Mitsui
pmc-13179475.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the prevalence and factors associated with nocturia, defined as ≥ 2 times/night, among participants from the 2023 Japan Community Health Survey (JaCS 2023).MethodsUsing data from JaCS 2023, a nationwide online survey comprising 48 questionnaire items on lower urinary tract symptoms and daily life, 6210 participants aged 20–99 years were evaluated.

pmc-13410727.title: Immunological Microenvironment Diversity in Homogeneous and Non-Homogeneous Oral Leukoplakia
pmc-13410727.creator: Ingrīda Čēma, Regīna Kleina, Madara Dzudzilo, Kristina Lasiené, Anita Dabužinskiene, Julianna Muceniece, Maksims Zolovs, Tālivaldis Freivalds
pmc-13410727.description: Oral leukoplakia (OL) is a potentially malignant lesion, but only a proportion of cases undergo transformation to carcinoma (7.2% to 9.5%). The aim of this study was to analyze the possible differences and the role of immune cells in homogeneous and non-homogeneous OL at different grades of dysplasia.

pmc-13486728.title: Oncogenic Ras drives EED degradation and PRC2 dysfunction to promote aggressive squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-13486728.creator: Meng-Yen Li, Aubrey Houser, Pradeep Cheema, Xiang Yu Zheng, Paula Restrepo, Pooja Flora, Yudong Zhou, Gil Segal-Dalal, Eldad Silberstein, Xiaotao Zhang, Markus Schober, Deyou Zheng, Idan Cohen, Andrew L Ji, Elena Ezhkova
pmc-13486728.description: Squamous cell carcinomas (SCCs) are common epithelial malignancies frequently associated with EZH2 upregulation, which correlates with aggressive growth and poor prognosis. EZH2 functions as the catalytic subunit of Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), which deposits the repressive H3K27me3 histone mark, yet PRC2 function in SCC pathogenesis remains unresolved.

pmc-13558254.title: Profiles and Prognostic Value of a Non-Invasive Liver Fibrosis Marker in Patients With Acute and Chronic Coronary Syndrome
pmc-13558254.creator: Wataru Saitoh, Takenobu Shimada, Daiju Fukuda, Atsushi Shibata, Asahiro Ito, Kenichiro Otsuka, Hiroshi Okamura, Tetsuya Matoba, Takahide Kohro, Yusuke Oba, Hisaki Makimoto, Tomoyuki Kabutoya, Yasushi Imai, Kazuomi Kario, Arihiro Kiyosue, Satoshi Kodera, Yoshiko Mizuno, Kotaro Nochioka, Masaharu Naka
pmc-13558254.description: BackgroundThe Fibrosis-4 (Fib-4) index, a non-invasive liver fibrosis marker, is useful for assessing cardiovascular risk; however, its role and profiles in patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS) and chronic coronary syndrome (CCS) remain unclear.Methods and ResultsWe analyzed 5,150 patients (ACS: 2,274; CCS: 2,876) from the Clinical Deep Data Accumulation System-Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (CLIDAS-PCI) database.

pmc-13577701.title: Heart failure‐induced reprogramming of salt‐evoked neurovascular coupling in the rat hypothalamus
pmc-13577701.creator: Ranjan K. Roy, Elba Campos Lira, Manuel Bita Ongolo, Jessica A. Filosa, Javier E. Stern
pmc-13577701.description: Neurovascular coupling (NVC) is essential for matching cerebral blood flow to neuronal activity. While NVC has been extensively studied in the cerebral cortex, far less is known about its regulation in deep brain regions such as the hypothalamus, particularly under pathological conditions.
